title: 流れ学Ⅱ
subtitle: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics II
keywords: Fluid properties 2.Momentum equation 3.Aerodynamic performance of wing 4.Similarity law 5.Local collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamentals of fluid dynamics and aerodynamics (2) learn the fluid properties of air because aircraft fly in the air (3) learn the measurement principles of fluid devices (4) learn fundamental equations and their application (5) learn the flow around an object
advice: This is a fundamental fluid dynamics and aerodynamics course. Students will learn fluid properties, fluid statics, inviscid flow, and incompressible flow. We will cover the following materials: 1. Bernoulli equation 2. Momentum equation 3. Forces and moments on a body 4. Laws of similarity Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses. Students are expected to solve the exercises by themselves to understand the course. Students are expected to actively participate in the presentation and discussion.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Fluid Mechanics I. Sufficient skill in mathematics and physics (dynamics)

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate fundamental fluid computation using continuum and Bernoulli equations
Be able to compute forces acting on a body using momentum conservation
Be able to understand and explain the basics of equation of fluid motion and continuity
Be able to derive the fundamental fluid equations
Be able to explain the flows around a body
